title: Quoting Ravi Vakil
description: Alessandro Masullo has a proposed proof of [Generalized Riemann Hypothesis], and Brian Conrad has been looking closely at it for months and gave extensive feedback which is being incorporated, and it is so far looking good. It is all human, with no AI. The hope was to bring Alessandro to Stanford for a year to polish…
